en.t: Byzantine emperor Michael I, under threat by conspiracies, abdicates in favor of his general Leo the Armenian, and becomes a monk (under the name Athanasius)
en.s: Leo V the Armenian (Greek: Λέων ὁ Ἀρμένιος, Léōn ō Arménios; c. 775 – 25 December 820) was the Byzantine emperor from 813 to 820. He is chiefly remembered for ending the decade-long war with the Bulgars, as well as initiating the second period of Byzantine iconoclasm. A senior general of Armenian origin, Leo distinguished himself under Nikephoros I and Michael I Rhangabe, eventually becoming the stratēgos of the Anatolic Theme.

zh.t: 拜占庭皇帝米海尔一世遭遇政变阴谋威胁后退位，将皇位让给将军亚美尼亚人利奥，并剃度为僧，法名阿塔纳修斯
zh.s: 亚美尼亚人利奥五世（希腊语：Λέων ὁ Ἀρμένιος，Léōn ō Arménios；约775年—820年12月25日）于813年至820年担任拜占庭皇帝。他因结束与保加利亚人持续十年的战争，以及开启拜占庭第二次圣像破坏运动而为人熟知。他是一位亚美尼亚裔高级将领，曾在尼基弗鲁斯一世和米海尔一世·兰加贝治下崭露头角，后来成为安纳托利亚军区的将军。

en.s: The treaty of Saint-Clair-sur-Epte (911) is the foundational treaty of the Duchy of Normandy, establishing Rollo, a Norse warlord and Viking leader, as the first Duke of Normandy in exchange for his loyalty to Charles III, the king of West Francia, following the Siege of Chartres. This treaty included a land grant of farmable coastal land from Charles to Rollo in return for Rollo's fealty and help against other Viking groups that had been regularly raiding the northern coastline.
en.n: Signing of the Treaty of Saint-Clair-sur-Epte between Charles the Simple and Rollo of Normandy.

zh.s: 圣克莱尔-埃普特条约（911年）是诺曼底公国的奠基性条约。沙特尔围城战后，西法兰克国王“糊涂查理”三世与诺斯战士首领罗洛缔约，罗洛宣誓效忠查理，并因此获立为诺曼底首位公爵。条约还规定，查理将一片适于耕种的沿海土地授予罗洛；作为交换，罗洛宣誓效忠并协助抵御经常袭扰北部海岸的其他维京人。
zh.n: 此条记录的是“糊涂查理”与诺曼底的罗洛签署圣克莱尔-埃普特条约。

en.t: Baldwin IV, 13, becomes King of Jerusalem, with Raymond III of Tripoli as regent and William of Tyre as chancellor
en.s: Baldwin IV (1161–1185), known as the Leper King, was the king of Jerusalem from 1174 until his death in 1185. Baldwin ascended to the throne when he was thirteen despite having leprosy. He made several attempts to curb the increasing power of the Muslim ruler Saladin, though much of his life was marked by infighting amongst the kingdom's nobles.

zh.t: 13岁的鲍德温四世成为耶路撒冷国王，由的黎波里伯爵雷蒙三世摄政，威廉·泰尔任大臣
zh.s: 鲍德温四世（1161—1185年），又称麻风王，自1174年起担任耶路撒冷国王，直至1185年去世。他虽患有麻风病，仍在13岁时继承王位。他曾多次试图遏制穆斯林统治者萨拉丁日益扩大的势力，但其统治时期很大程度上受到王国贵族内斗影响。

en.s: The Battle of the Golden Spurs (Dutch: Guldensporenslag; French: Bataille des éperons d'or) or Battle of Courtrai was a military confrontation between the royal army of France and rebellious forces of the County of Flanders on 11 July 1302 during the 1297–1305 Franco-Flemish War. It took place near the town of Kortrijk in modern-day Belgium and resulted in an unexpected victory for the Flemish.

zh.s: 金马刺战役（荷兰语：Guldensporenslag；法语：Bataille des éperons d’or），又称科特赖克战役，是法国王军与佛兰德伯国叛军于1302年7月11日爆发的一场军事冲突，属于1297年至1305年的法兰德斯—法国战争。战斗发生在今比利时科特赖克镇附近，结果出乎意料：佛兰德斯军队获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Aldy Charrish (also known as the Battle of Auldicharish, Aldicharrish, Aldecharwis, Alt a'Charrais, Alt Charrais, Alt na Charrais) was a Scottish clan battle that took place on 11 July 1487. The Clan Mackay and possibly the Clan Sutherland defeated the Clan Ross and their allies in the Scottish Highlands, probably on the south side of Strathoykel.

zh.s: 奥尔迪查里什战役（又称Auldicharish、Aldicharrish、Aldecharwis、Alt a’Charrais、Alt Charrais或Alt na Charrais）是1487年7月11日发生的一场苏格兰氏族战斗。麦凯氏族以及可能还有萨瑟兰氏族在苏格兰高地击败了罗斯氏族及其盟友。战斗地点可能在斯特拉斯奥伊克尔南侧。

en.s: The siege of Arai (新井城の戦い) was among the first steps taken by Hōjō Sōun towards becoming one of the most powerful warlords of Japan's Sengoku period. After attacking Kamakura in 1512, Hōjō turned to Arai castle, on Miura Peninsula, to the south, which was controlled by Miura Yoshiatsu. Miura Yoshiatsu's son Yoshimoto, believing defeat to be inevitable, killed himself by chopping off his own head.

zh.s: 新井城之战（新井城の戦い）是北条早云迈向成为日本战国时代最强势大名之一的早期行动。1512年攻打镰仓后，北条军转而进攻南面的三浦半岛上的新井城。城堡由三浦义同控制。三浦义同之子三浦义意认为败局已定，便自行砍下头颅自尽。

en.t: While exploring the North Atlantic Ocean in an attempt to find the Northwest Passage, Martin Frobisher sights Greenland, mistaking it for the hypothesized (but non-existent) island of "Frisland"
en.s: The Atlantic Ocean is the second largest of the world's five oceans, with an area of about 85,133,000 square kilometers (32,870,000 sq mi). It covers approximately 17% of Earth's surface and about 24% of its water surface area. During the Age of Discovery, it was known for separating the New World of the Americas (North America and South America) from the Old World of Afro-Eurasia (Africa, Asia, and Europe).

zh.t: 马丁·弗罗比舍探索北大西洋、试图寻找西北航道时看见格陵兰岛，却误以为那是传说中并不存在的“弗里斯兰岛”
zh.s: 大西洋是世界五大洋中的第二大洋，面积约为85,133,000平方公里（32,870,000平方英里）。它覆盖地球表面约17%，约占地球水面面积的24%。大航海时代，人们认为大西洋将美洲新大陆（北美和南美）与亚非欧旧大陆分隔开来。

en.s: The siege of Pembroke took place in 1648 during the Second English Civil War. In the engagement, Parliamentarian troops led by Oliver Cromwell besieged Pembroke Castle in Wales. The Castle had become a refuge for rebellious Parliamentarian soldiers after the end of the First English Civil War.

en.s: The Battle of Magierów took place on 11 July 1657, during Polish history known as the Swedish Deluge. Polish army commanded by Stefan Czarniecki, and supported by Crimean Tatars, defeated a Transilvanian-Cossack-Moldavian-Wallachian army of George II Rákóczi.

zh.s: 马盖耶鲁夫战役发生于1657年7月11日，属于波兰史称“瑞典洪水”的战争时期。斯特凡·恰尔涅茨基率领的波兰军队在克里米亚鞑靼人支援下，击败了乔治二世·拉科齐率领的特兰西瓦尼亚—哥萨克—摩尔达维亚—瓦拉几亚联军。

en.s: The Battle of Oudenarde, also known as the Battle of Oudenaarde, was a major engagement of the War of the Spanish Succession, pitting an Anglo-Dutch force consisting of eighty thousand men under the command of the Duke of Marlborough, Lord Overkirk and Prince Eugene of Savoy against a French force of eighty-five thousand men under the command of the Duc de Bourgogne and the Duc de Vendôme, the battle resulting in a great victory for the Grand Alliance. The battle was fought near the city of Oudenaarde, at the time part of the Spanish Netherlands, on 11 July 1708.

zh.s: 奥德纳尔德战役又称奥德纳尔德会战，是西班牙王位继承战争中的一场重要战役。由马尔博罗公爵、欧弗凯尔克勋爵和萨伏依的欧根亲王指挥的八万名英荷联军，与由勃艮第公爵和旺多姆公爵指挥的八万五千名法军交战，最终大同盟取得重大胜利。战斗于1708年7月11日在奥德纳尔德城附近发生；该地当时属于西属尼德兰。

en.s: The Battle at Port-la-Joye (also known as the Port-la-Joye Massacre) was a battle in King George's War that took place between the British Army and a combined force of French troops and Mi'kmaq militia on the banks of present-day Hillsborough River, Prince Edward Island in the summer of 1746.

zh.s: 普特拉茹瓦战役又称普特拉茹瓦大屠杀，是乔治王战争期间英国陆军与法国军队、米克马克民兵组成的联军之间的一场战斗。战斗发生于1746年夏，地点在今爱德华王子岛希尔斯伯勒河岸边。

en.s: The Battle of Norwalk (also known as the Battle of West Rocks or Battle of the Rocks) was a series of skirmishes between the Thirteen Colonies and Great Britain during the American Revolutionary War. The attack was one part of a series of raids on coastal Connecticut towns collectively known as Tryon's raid. The battle was fought in Norwalk, Connecticut on July 11, 1779. 70th (Surrey) Regiment of Foot of Great Britain commanded by Major General William Tryon arrived on July 10, 1779.

zh.s: 诺沃克战役（又称西岩战役或岩石战役）是美国独立战争期间，北美十三殖民地与英国之间的一系列小规模战斗。此次进攻是特赖恩突袭的一部分；特赖恩突袭是对康涅狄格州沿海城镇的一系列袭击。战斗于1779年7月11日在康涅狄格州诺沃克发生。英国第70步兵团（萨里团）由威廉·特赖恩少将指挥，于1779年7月10日抵达。

en.s: The Treaty of Amity, Commerce, and Navigation, Between His Britannic Majesty and the United States of America, commonly known as the Jay Treaty, and also as Jay's Treaty, was a 1794 treaty between the United States and Great Britain that averted war, resolved issues remaining since the 1783 Treaty of Paris (which ended the American Revolutionary War), and facilitated ten years of peaceful trade between Americans and the British in the midst of the French Revolutionary Wars, which had begun in 1792.
en.n: The United States takes possession of Detroit from Great Britain under terms of the Jay Treaty.

zh.s: 《友好、通商与航海条约》是大不列颠国王与美利坚合众国签订的条约，通常称为《杰伊条约》，也称杰伊协议。该条约于1794年缔结，避免了美国与英国之间的战争，解决了1783年《巴黎条约》（结束美国独立战争）后遗留的问题，并促成两国在始于1792年的法国大革命战争期间维持了十年和平贸易。
zh.n: 根据《杰伊条约》条款，美国接管底特律。

en.s: The Battle of Martinići (Albanian: Beteja e Martinicit) was fought between Montenegro and the Pashalik of Scutari. It took place on the outskirts of the village Martinići, near Spuž in Montenegro. Following the unification of Montenegro with Brda, the Ottoman governor of the Pashalik of Scutari launched a military offensive onto Montenegrin territory. Two Montenegrin divisions, led by Prince-bishop Petar I Petrović-Njegoš and guvernadur Jovan Radonjić, containing 3,000 men, took positions near Martinići.

zh.s: 马尔蒂尼奇战役（阿尔巴尼亚语：Beteja e Martinicit）是黑山与斯库台帕夏领地之间的一场战斗，发生在黑山斯普日附近的马尔蒂尼奇村郊外。黑山与布尔达统一后，斯库台帕夏领地的奥斯曼总督向黑山领土发动军事进攻。由主教兼亲王彼得一世·彼得罗维奇-涅戈什和总督约万·拉多尼奇率领的两支黑山部队共3,000人，在马尔蒂尼奇附近布阵。

en.s: The Battle of Clonard occurred on 11 July 1798 near Leinster Bridge in the townland of Clonard New, County Kildare during the Irish Rising of that year. A combined force of between 2,000 and 4,000 United Irishmen engaged a force of 27 British loyalist militia troops led by Lieutenant Thomas Tyrrell over 6 hours in an attempt to cross the River Boyne.

zh.s: 克洛纳德战役于1798年7月11日在基尔代尔郡克洛纳德新镇区的莱恩斯特桥附近发生，正值当年的爱尔兰起义。人数在2,000至4,000之间的爱尔兰联合会成员与27名英国保皇派民兵交战，后者由托马斯·泰瑞尔中尉率领。双方激战六小时，爱尔兰联合会成员试图渡过博因河。

en.t: French astronomer Jean-Louis Pons makes his first comet discovery. In the next 27 years he discovers another 36 comets, more than any other person in history
en.s: Jean-Louis Pons (24 December 1761 – 14 October 1831) was a French astronomer. Despite humble beginnings and being self-taught, he went on to become the greatest visual comet discoverer of all time: between 1801 and 1827 Pons discovered thirty-seven comets, more than any other person in history. Pons worked at three observatories in his career, Marseille Observatory, where he was also trained, a short-lived observatory at Royal Park La Marlia in Tuscany, and finally at an observatory in Florence.

zh.t: 法国天文学家让-路易·庞斯首次发现彗星；此后27年间又发现36颗，超过历史上任何人
zh.s: 让-路易·庞斯（1761年12月24日—1831年10月14日）是法国天文学家。他出身平凡，靠自学成才，后来成为历史上最杰出的目视彗星发现者：1801年至1827年间，他发现37颗彗星，数量超过历史上任何人。他职业生涯中曾在三座天文台工作：他受训并工作的马赛天文台、托斯卡纳拉马尔利亚皇家公园的一座短期天文台，以及最后任职的佛罗伦萨天文台。

en.s: The action of 11 July 1804 was a minor naval engagement fought between the Royal Navy and the French Imperial Navy in the Bay of Hiérès, off Le Lavandou. On 11 July, at night, 10 boats belonging to the Royal Navy frigates Narcissus, Seahorse, and Maidstone, under the orders of Lieutenant John Thompson, attacked 12 French settees, lying at Lavandou, in Hiérès Bay, moored with chains to the beach, and covered by a battery of three guns.

zh.s: 1804年7月11日海战是英国皇家海军与法国帝国海军在耶尔湾（勒拉旺杜外海）进行的一场小规模海战。7月11日晚，约翰·汤普森中尉指挥英国皇家海军纳西瑟斯号、海马号和梅德斯通号护卫舰上的10艘小艇，袭击了停泊在拉旺杜、以缆链系在岸边并由一座装有三门炮的炮台掩护的12艘法国小型帆船。

en.s: Following defeat at the Battle of Wagram, Archduke Charles retreated north into Bohemia hoping to regroup his battered forces. The French army had also suffered in the battle and did not give immediate pursuit. But two days after the battle, Napoleon ordered his troops north intending to defeat the Austrians once and for all. The French eventually caught up the Austrians at Znaim (now Znojmo, Czech Republic) on 10 July 1809.

en.s: The Combat of Barquilla (11 July 1810) was a minor skirmish between British and French forces two days after the siege of Ciudad Rodrigo, in which Robert Craufurd attacked French grenadiers covering a foraging party. The French grenadiers, formed in a single square, made a fighting withdrawal, fending off British cavalry and escaping unscathed.

zh.s: 巴基利亚交战发生于1810年7月11日，是西达德罗德里戈围城战两天后英国与法国军队之间的一场小规模战斗。罗伯特·克劳弗德袭击了为一支觅食队伍提供掩护的法国掷弹兵。法国掷弹兵列成一个方阵，在抵挡英国骑兵的同时有序撤退，最终毫发无损地脱身。

en.s: The Raid on Black Rock took place during the War of 1812 between the United Kingdom and the United States on 11 July 1813, near the Niagara River in western New York, United States. The British objective was to capture supplies and equipment from the U.S. military store depot at Black Rock. The raid was a success but the British force suffered substantial casualties as they returned to their landing-point.

zh.s: 黑岩突袭发生于1812年战争期间，交战双方是英国和美国。1813年7月11日，英军在美国纽约州西部、尼亚加拉河附近发动突袭，目标是从美国军方设在黑岩的军需仓库夺取补给和装备。突袭取得成功，但英军返回登陆点时伤亡惨重。

en.s: The Battle of the Tagus took place on 11 July 1831 during the Liberal Wars. At the mouth of the Tagus river in Portugal, a French fleet attacked and subdued Miguelite fortifications with the aim of forcing the regime of Miguel I of Portugal to recognise the newly established July Monarchy in France.

zh.s: 塔霍河战役发生于1831年7月11日，是自由主义战争的一部分。法国舰队在葡萄牙塔霍河口袭击并压制了米格尔派的防御工事，意图迫使葡萄牙米格尔一世政权承认法国新成立的七月王朝。

en.t: The Fly-fisher's Entomology is published by Alfred Ronalds. The book transformed the sport and went to many editions
en.s: The Fly-Fisher's Entomology, Illustrated by Coloured Representations of the Natural and Artificial Insect and Accompanied by a Few Observations and Instructions Relative to Trout-and-Grayling Fishing, first published in 1836 by Alfred Ronalds (1802–1860), was the first comprehensive work related to the entomology associated with fly fishing. Although the work was Ronalds' only book, it was published in 11 editions between 1836 and 1913 and has been extensively reprinted in the last 100 years.

zh.s: 《飞钓昆虫学：配有天然及人工昆虫的彩色图示，并附有关于鳟鱼和河鳟垂钓的观察与说明》由阿尔弗雷德·罗纳兹（1802—1860）撰写，于1836年首次出版。这是第一部全面介绍飞钓相关昆虫学的著作。尽管这是罗纳兹唯一的一本书，该书在1836年至1913年间共出版11个版本，并在之后100多年里多次再版。

en.s: Waterloo station ( ), also known as London Waterloo, is a major central London railway terminus on the National Rail network in the United Kingdom, in the Waterloo area of the London Borough of Lambeth. It is connected to a London Underground station of the same name and is adjacent to Waterloo East station on the South Eastern Main Line.

On 11 July the Hungarian army started to attack the Austrians.

zh.s: 科马罗姆第三次战役的主要目标是击退奥地利军队，为匈牙利军队向东南撤退创造条件。匈牙利政府同意向朱利叶斯·雅各布·冯·海瑙率领的奥军发动进攻；奥军驻扎在科马罗姆要塞的东面和东南面。7月11日，匈牙利军队开始进攻奥军。

en.t: 1860 civil conflict in Mount Lebanon and Damascus
en.s: The 1860 civil conflict in Mount Lebanon and Damascus, also known as the 1860 Christian–Druze war, was a civil conflict in Mount Lebanon during Ottoman rule in 1860–1861 fought mainly between the local Druze and Christians. Following decisive Druze victories and massacres of the Christians, the conflict spilled over into other parts of Ottoman Syria, particularly Damascus, where thousands of Christian residents were killed by Druze fighters and local Muslim groups.

zh.s: 1860年黎巴嫩山和大马士革内乱又称1860年基督徒与德鲁兹人战争，是奥斯曼统治期间（1860—1861年）发生在黎巴嫩山的一场内战，主要交战双方为当地德鲁兹人和基督徒。德鲁兹人取得决定性胜利并屠杀基督徒后，冲突蔓延到奥斯曼叙利亚的其他地区，尤其是大马士革。德鲁兹战士和当地穆斯林团体在那里杀害了数千名基督徒居民。

en.s: The Battle of Fort Stevens was an American Civil War battle fought July 11–12, 1864, in Northwest Washington, D.C., as part of the Valley Campaigns of 1864 between forces under Confederate Lieutenant General Jubal A. Early and Union Major General Alexander McDowell McCook. Although Early caused consternation in the Union government, reinforcements under Maj. Gen. Horatio G. Wright and the strong defenses of Fort Stevens minimized the military threat and Early withdrew after two days of skirmishing without attempting any serious assaults. The battle is noted for the personal presence of President Abraham Lincoln observing the fighting.

zh.s: 史蒂文斯堡战役是美国内战期间的一场战役，于1864年7月11日至12日在华盛顿特区西北部发生，属于1864年谢南多厄谷战役的一部分，交战双方为邦联中将朱巴尔·A·厄尔利所部和联邦少将亚历山大·麦克道尔·麦库克所部。厄尔利一度让联邦政府感到不安，但霍雷肖·G·赖特少将率领的增援部队和史蒂文斯堡坚固的防御削弱了军事威胁。厄尔利在两天的零星交火后撤退，没有发动大规模进攻。这场战役以亚伯拉罕·林肯总统亲自到场观看战斗而闻名。

en.s: The Battle of Alegre was a naval battle of the Paraguayan War fought on July 11, 1867, near the city of Corumbá, on the São Lourenço River, present-day Mato Grosso do Sul, between Brazilians and Paraguayans. During the supply of meat, "carnage", for the troops that were there, coming from the resumption of Corumbá, a small squad of Paraguayan vapors had gone up the river in pursuit of the Brazilians, after the first ones had been defeated.

zh.s: 阿莱格里战役是巴拉圭战争期间的一场海战，于1867年7月11日在巴西人与巴拉圭人之间爆发，地点在科伦巴城附近的圣洛伦索河（今巴西南马托格罗索州）。科伦巴被重新夺回后，当地部队需要补充肉类。在为部队运送肉类（即“屠宰牲畜”）时，一支小型巴拉圭蒸汽船队沿河追击巴西人；此前，巴拉圭船队已在前一次交战中落败。

en.s: The Battle of Summit Springs, on July 11, 1869, was an armed conflict between elements of the United States Army under the command of Colonel Eugene A. Carr and a group of Cheyenne Dog Soldiers led by Tall Bull, who was killed during the engagement. The US forces were assigned to retaliate for a series of raids in north-central Kansas by Chief Tall Bull's Dog Soldiers band of the Cheyenne. The battle happened south of Sterling, Colorado in Washington County near the Logan/Washington county line.

zh.s: 萨米特斯普林斯战役发生于1869年7月11日，是美国陆军尤金·A·卡尔上校所部与塔尔布尔率领的一支夏延族“狗兵”战士队伍之间的武装冲突。塔尔布尔在战斗中被杀。此前，塔尔布尔的部族多次袭击堪萨斯州中北部，美国军队因此奉命进行报复。战斗发生在科罗拉多州斯特林以南的华盛顿县，靠近洛根县与华盛顿县的交界处。

en.s: The Battle of the Assem River was fought in 1871 between the forces of Kassa Mercha of Tigray and Emperor Tekle Giyorgis II. It resulted in victory for Kassa, allowing him to eventually become crowned as Emperor of Ethiopia. This battle has been noted by some as one of the first 'truly modern' battles in Ethiopian history, given that the tactics used by Kassa of Tigray revolved around the use of gunpowder weaponry.

zh.s: 阿瑟姆河战役于1871年爆发，交战双方是提格雷的卡萨·梅尔查所部与皇帝特克勒·吉约吉斯二世。卡萨获胜，并最终得以加冕为埃塞俄比亚皇帝。有些人认为，这场战役是埃塞俄比亚史上首批“真正现代化”的战役之一，因为提格雷的卡萨所用战术以火药武器为主。

en.s: The Bombardment of Alexandria in Egypt by the British Mediterranean Fleet took place on 11–13 July 1882. Admiral Beauchamp Seymour was in command of a fleet of fifteen Royal Navy ironclad ships which had previously sailed to the harbor of Alexandria to support the khedive Tewfik Pasha amid Ahmed 'Urabi's nationalist uprising against his administration and its close ties to British and French financiers.

zh.s: 1882年7月11日至13日，英国地中海舰队炮击埃及亚历山大港。舰队由海军上将博尚·西摩指挥，共有15艘皇家海军铁甲舰。此前，这支舰队驶入亚历山大港，支持赫迪夫陶菲克帕夏；当时艾哈迈德·乌拉比领导的民族主义起义正反对其政府及其与英国、法国金融家的密切关系。

en.s: Tijuana is the most populous city of the Mexican state of Baja California, located on the northwestern Pacific Coast of Mexico. It is the municipal seat of the Tijuana Municipality, the hub of the Tijuana metropolitan area and the most populous city in northern Mexico. Tijuana is just south of California and is adjacent to the Mexico–United States border which is part of the San Diego–Tijuana metro area.

zh.s: 蒂华纳是墨西哥下加利福尼亚州人口最多的城市，位于墨西哥西北太平洋沿岸。它是蒂华纳市的市政中心，也是蒂华纳都会区的枢纽和墨西哥北部人口最多的城市。蒂华纳位于加利福尼亚州以南，毗邻墨西哥—美国边界，属于圣迭戈—蒂华纳都会区。

en.s: FIAT Automobiles S.p.A., commonly known as FIAT (UK: FEE-ət, -⁠at, US: -⁠aht; Italian: [ˈfiːat]), is an Italian automobile manufacturer. FIAT Automobiles was formed in January 2007 when FIAT Group reorganized its automobile business, and traces its history back to 1899, when the first FIAT automobile, the FIAT 3½ HP, was produced. It became a part of FIAT-Chrysler Automobiles (FCA) when the FIAT Group merged with the US Chrysler Group in 2014.

zh.t: 乔瓦尼·阿涅利在意大利都灵创立菲亚特
zh.s: 菲亚特汽车股份公司（FIAT；英国英语读作FEE-ət或-⁠at，美国英语读作-⁠aht；意大利语：[ˈfiːat]）是意大利汽车制造商。菲亚特汽车于2007年1月成立，当时菲亚特集团重组了汽车业务；其历史可追溯至1899年，当年生产了首辆菲亚特汽车FIAT 3½ HP。2014年菲亚特集团与美国克莱斯勒集团合并后，菲亚特成为菲亚特克莱斯勒汽车公司（FCA）的一部分。

en.s: The Battle of Silkaatsnek (Afrikaans: Slag van Silkaatsnek, English: Battle of Zilikat's (Silikat's, Uitval's or Nitral's) Nek, or First Battle of Silkaatsnek) was a military engagement in the Anglo-Boer War on July 11, 1900, at the Silkaatsnek mountain pass, between Pretoria and Rustenburg. Boer guerrillas under assistant-commander general Koos de la Rey surprised British troops, using a new guerrilla tactic instead of fighting a set-piece battle.

zh.s: 西尔卡茨内克战役（南非语：Slag van Silkaatsnek；英语又称Zilikat山口、Silikat山口、Uitval山口或Nitral山口战役，也称第一次西尔卡茨内克战役）是第二次布尔战争期间于1900年7月11日在西尔卡茨内克山口发生的一场交战。该山口位于比勒陀利亚和勒斯滕堡之间。由助理总司令库斯·德·拉雷率领的布尔游击队出其不意地袭击英军，采用了新的游击战术，没有与对方进行阵地战。

en.s: General elections were held in Mexico on 11 July 1904. Incumbent Porfirio Díaz was the only serious candidate for the presidency, and was re-elected with 100% of the vote. Ramón Corral became the first Mexican vice president in decades, and the first elected via popular vote. The only other presidential candidate, the perennial Nicolás Zúñiga y Miranda, received no votes.

zh.s: 墨西哥于1904年7月11日举行大选。时任总统波菲里奥·迪亚斯是总统选举中唯一有力的候选人，并以100%的得票率再次当选。拉蒙·科拉尔成为数十年来首位墨西哥副总统，也是首位经普选产生的副总统。另一位总统候选人、屡次参选的尼古拉斯·苏尼加·米兰达没有获得任何选票。

en.s: The 1912 Saskatchewan general election was held on July 11, 1912 to elect members of the Legislative Assembly of Saskatchewan. Premier Walter Scott led the Liberal Party of Saskatchewan to a third term in office with a significant increase in the share of the popular vote. The opposition, now renamed from the Provincial Rights Party to the Conservative Party of Saskatchewan and led by Wellington Bartley Willoughby, lost both votes and seats in the legislature.

zh.s: 1912年7月11日，萨斯喀彻温省举行大选，选出该省立法议会议员。省长沃尔特·斯科特领导萨斯喀彻温自由党第三次执政，得票率显著上升。反对党由省权利党更名为萨斯喀彻温保守党，并由威灵顿·巴特利·威洛比领导；该党在得票数和议会席位上均有所减少。

en.s: The East Prussian plebiscite (German: Volksabstimmung in Ostpreußen), also known as the Allenstein and Marienwerder plebiscite or Warmia, Masuria and Powiśle plebiscite (Polish: Plebiscyt na Warmii, Mazurach i Powiślu), was a plebiscite for the self-determination of the regions of southern Warmia (Ermland), Masuria (Mazury, Masuren) and Powiśle, which had been in parts of the East Prussian Government Region of Allenstein and of the West Prussian Government Region of Marienwerder in accordance with Articles 94 to 97 of the Treaty of Versailles. Prepared in early 1920, the plebiscite took place on 11 July 1920 and was conducted by German authorities under Inter-Allied control.

zh.s: 东普鲁士公民投票（德语：Volksabstimmung in Ostpreußen），又称阿伦施泰因和马林韦尔德公民投票，或瓦尔米亚、马祖里和波维希莱公民投票（波兰语：Plebiscyt na Warmii, Mazurach i Powiślu），是围绕南瓦尔米亚（埃尔姆兰）、马祖里和波维希莱地区自决问题举行的公民投票。根据《凡尔赛条约》第94至97条，这些地区分别属于东普鲁士阿伦施泰因行政区和西普鲁士马林韦尔德行政区。公投筹备工作于1920年初开始，并于1920年7月11日举行，由德国当局在协约国监督下组织。

en.s: The Irish War of Independence (Irish: Cogadh na Saoirse), also known as the Anglo-Irish War or the Tan War, was a guerrilla war fought in Ireland from 1919 to 1921 between the Irish Republican Army (IRA, the army of the Irish Republic) and British forces: the British Army, along with the quasi-military Royal Irish Constabulary (RIC) and its paramilitary forces the Auxiliaries and Ulster Special Constabulary (USC).

en.s: The Allied invasion of Sicily, also known as the Battle of Sicily and Operation Husky, was a major campaign of World War II in which Allied forces invaded the Italian island of Sicily in July 1943 and took it from the Axis forces. en.s: The Battle of Enogai was a battle between United States and Imperial Japanese Army and Navy forces on 10–11 July 1943. en.s: Operation Jupiter was an offensive by VIII Corps of the British Second Army from 10 to 11 July 1944 during the Battle of Normandy in the Second World War. The objective of the 43rd (Wessex) Infantry Division (Major-General Ivor Thomas) was to capture the villages of Baron-sur-Odon, Fontaine-Étoupefour, Château de Fontaine-Étoupefour and to capture the high ground of Hill 112 in order to deny its use as an observation point.

zh.s: 木星行动是第二次世界大战诺曼底战役期间，英国第二集团军第八军于1944年7月10日至11日发动的一次攻势。第43（威塞克斯）步兵师由艾弗·托马斯少将指挥，目标是夺取巴龙-叙尔-奥东、枫丹-埃图福尔和枫丹-埃图福尔城堡，并占领112高地，以防敌方将其用作观察点。

en.s: Senator Richard M. Nixon's speech at a state Republican Party fundraiser in New York City on May 8, 1952, impressed Governor Thomas E. en.t: To Kill a Mockingbird by Harper Lee is first published, in the United States
en.s: To Kill a Mockingbird is a 1960 Southern Gothic novel by American author Harper Lee. It became instantly successful after its release; in the United States, it is widely read in high schools and middle schools. To Kill a Mockingbird won the Pulitzer Prize a year after its release, and it has become a classic of modern American literature.

en.t: Treaty on Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance between China and North Korea
en.s: The Treaty on Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance between the People's Republic of China and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea is a defense pact between the People's Republic of China and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. en.s: The 1963 Ecuadorian coup d'état was the successful government takeover in Ecuador of the military against the democratic administration of Carlos Julio Arosemena Monroy, establishing a four-man military junta led by Ramon Castro Jijon. The junta ruled the country until 1966, when it was overthrown in another coup d'état by the High Command of the Armed Forces.

zh.s: 1963年厄瓜多尔政变是一起成功的军事夺权行动，推翻了卡洛斯·胡利奥·阿罗塞梅纳·蒙罗伊的民选政府，并建立由拉蒙·卡斯特罗·希洪领导的四人军政府。军政府统治该国直至1966年，随后在另一场政变中被武装部队最高指挥部推翻。

en.s: The 1965 Cupa României final was the 27th final of Romania's most prestigious football cup competition. It was disputed between Știința Cluj and Dinamo Pitești and was won by Știința after a game with three goals. It was the first cup for Știința Cluj.

zh.s: 1965年罗马尼亚杯决赛是罗马尼亚最高级别足球杯赛的第27届决赛，由克卢日科学队对阵皮特什蒂迪纳摩队。克卢日科学队在一场共打入3球的比赛中获胜，这是该队首次夺得杯赛冠军。

en.s: The World Chess Championship 1972 was a match for the World Chess Championship between challenger Bobby Fischer of the United States and defending champion Boris Spassky of the Soviet Union. The match took place in the Laugardalshöll in Reykjavík, Iceland, and has been dubbed the Match of the Century. Fischer became the first US-born player to win the world title. Fischer's win also ended, for a short time, 24 years of Soviet domination of the World Championship. Fischer won the right to challenge for the World Championship after dominant performances during the qualification cycle, in which he defeated some of the world's leading players by unprecedented margins. The first game was played on July 11, 1972.

zh.s: 1972年世界国际象棋锦标赛是美国挑战者鲍比·菲舍尔与苏联卫冕冠军鲍里斯·斯帕斯基之间的一场世界冠军赛。比赛在冰岛雷克雅未克的劳加达尔体育馆举行，后来被称为“世纪之战”。菲舍尔成为首位赢得世界冠军的美国出生棋手。他的胜利也短暂终结了苏联对世界冠军赛长达24年的统治。菲舍尔在此前的资格赛中表现出压倒性优势，击败了多位世界顶尖棋手，且胜出幅度前所未有，因此获得挑战世界冠军的资格。首盘比赛于1972年7月11日进行。

en.s: Varig Flight 820 was a scheduled international passenger flight from Galeão Airport, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil to Orly Airport, Paris, France. On 11 July 1973, the Boeing 707 made an emergency landing in a field in Saulx-les-Chartreux, a commune located about 5 km south of the destination airport, due to smoke in the cabin.

en.s: The Los Alfaques disaster was a road accident and tanker explosion which occurred on 11 July 1978 in Alcanar, near Tarragona, in Spain. The tanker truck was loaded with 23 tons of highly flammable liquefied propylene. 217 people (including the driver) were killed and 200 more severely burned. Most of the victims were vacationers in the Los Alfaques seaside campsite. The campsite is located at km 159 on the N-340 national road, 2 km south of the town of Sant Carles de la Ràpita. It has been renovated since and still exists today.

zh.s: 洛斯阿尔法克斯灾难是一起公路事故和油罐车爆炸，发生于1978年7月11日，地点在西班牙阿尔卡纳尔，靠近塔拉戈纳。油罐车载有23吨高度易燃的液态丙烯。事故造成217人死亡（包括司机），另有200人严重烧伤。大多数受害者当时在洛斯阿尔法克斯海滨露营地度假。露营地位于N-340国道159公里处，圣卡洛斯-德拉拉皮塔镇以南2公里。此后露营地经过翻修，至今仍在运营。

en.s: The final match of the 1982 FIFA World Cup, the twelfth edition of FIFA's competition for men's national football teams, was played at the Bernabéu in Madrid, Spain, on 11 July 1982, and was contested by Italy and West Germany. The tournament featured host Spain and defending champions Argentina, as well as 22 other teams who emerged from the qualification phase, organized by the six FIFA confederations. The 24 teams completed in the first group stage, in which 12 teams qualified for the second group stage, before four teams advanced to the knockout stage.

en.s: TAME Flight 173, a Boeing 737-200 operated by Ecuador's national airline TAME, flying on a domestic route from the now-closed Mariscal Sucre International Airport in Quito to Mariscal Lamar International Airport in Cuenca, crashed on 11 July 1983 into a hill during its final approach just 1 mile (1.6 km; 0.87 nmi) from its final destination, killing all 119 people on board.

en.s: Federal elections were held in Australia on 11 July 1987, following the granting of a double dissolution on 5 June by the Governor-General Sir Ninian Stephen. en.s: The Battle of Kokavil (Sinhala: කොකාවිල් සටන) was fought from 27 June to 11 July 1990 in Kokavil, Sri Lanka. The Sri Lankan military camp at Kokavil was put to siege by the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) for 14 days before they captured it. Of the 54 Sri Lankan Army soldiers stationed in the base at the time, only 2 and a civilian cook reached friendly lines after the battle, with all others having been presumably killed by the LTTE.

en.s: The Srebrenica massacre, also known as the Srebrenica genocide, was the July 1995 genocidal killing of more than 8,000 Bosniak men and boys in and around the town of Srebrenica during the Bosnian War. It was mainly perpetrated by units of the Bosnian Serb Army of Republika Srpska under Ratko Mladić, though the Serb paramilitary unit Scorpions also participated.

en.s: The siege of Srebrenica (Serbo-Croatian: Opsada Srebrenice, Опсада Сребреницe) was a three-year siege of the town of Srebrenica in eastern Bosnia and Herzegovina which lasted from April 1992 to July 1995 during the Bosnian War. Initially assaulted by the Yugoslav People's Army (JNA) and the Serbian Volunteer Guard (SDG), the town was encircled by the Army of Republika Srpska (VRS) in May 1992, starting a brutal siege which was to last for the majority of the Bosnian War.

en.s: The Evangelos Florakis Naval Base explosion was the worst peacetime military accident ever recorded in Cyprus. The incident occurred on 11 July 2011, when 98 containers of explosives that had been stored for 2½ years in the sun on the Evangelos Florakis Naval Base near Zygi self-detonated. The resulting explosion killed 13 people, 12 of them immediately, including Captain Andreas Ioannides, the Commander of the Navy (Cyprus's most senior naval officer), and the base commander, Lambros Lambrou. Also killed were four navy personnel and six firefighters, while a further 62 people were injured.

zh.t: 埃万杰洛斯·弗洛拉基斯海军基地爆炸

en.s: The 2020 Louisiana Democratic presidential primary took place on July 11, 2020, a Saturday, in the Democratic Party primaries for the 2020 presidential election. en.s: 2025 Ablekuma North parliamentary election rerun was held on 11 July 2025 in the Ablekuma North constituency of Ghana’s Greater Accra Region. The rerun took place in 19 polling stations following a legal dispute and the Electoral Commission’s inability to complete results collation from the original 2024 general election.
